messages:
Maria (People Ops): quick policy q — if someone calls in sick the morning of a scheduled hybrid on-site day, can they use a floating holiday to cover the office shift? need guidance for same-day coverage rota.
Devon (eng): is this about John? he messaged me at 9:05. said he woke up with a fever.
Anna (Team Lead): yup, john. we have client on-site support this afternoon so need to sort coverage. can someone pick up his desk hours?
Oliver (SRE): I can cover the 1–3pm desk block if needed.
Ben (People Ops): short answer — yes, but process matters. employees should still mark the day in the HR portal as either SICK or FLOATING HOLIDAY (not both). managers approve.
Maria (People Ops): ok, two follow-ups: 1) can manager retro-approve same-day? 2) if they choose floating holiday instead of sick, does it affect accrual/carryover?
Ben (People Ops): 1) managers can approve same-day submissions; we ask for approvals within 24 hours to keep payroll/coverage records clean. 2) floating holidays are separate from sick accruals and do not reduce sick bank; they follow carryover rules in the handbook (floaters expire end of year unless used).
Priya (People Ops): adding: if employee is ill, encourage SICK for documentation/benefits. floating holiday should be used for planned personal time. using floaters for sick is allowed occasionally, but we shouldn't require medical note for single-day cold.
Devon (eng): got it. what should john select now? he's currently at home.
Maria (People Ops): john should file SICK in the portal. if he prefers to preserve a floater, he can DM his manager and request to use a floating holiday, manager can approve in the portal and add a short note.
Anna (Team Lead): I'm fine with Oliver covering. john — please submit in portal and tag me. I'll approve within the hour.
HR Bot: Reminder: managers, please approve time-off requests within 24 hours. For same-day sick, mark request type clearly. See policy: https://company-hr.example/time-off (internal link).
Oliver (SRE): confirmed — i'll take 1–3pm desk.
Maria (People Ops): sample coverage mini-rotadata — paste into channel so leads can copy:
```
Mon: Alice 9–11am
Tue: Ben 11–1pm
Wed: Oliver 1–3pm  <-- temporary swap today
Thu: Devon 3–5pm
Fri: Team rota free
```
Anna (Team Lead): perfect, will slot that into our on-call doc. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Devon (eng): heads-up — can we add a blurb to the handbook about using floaters vs sick for same-day calls? seems to come up weekly.
Priya (People Ops): yes — i'll draft a 2-line clarification and circulate for feedback tomorrow.
Maria (People Ops): thanks — action items: john to submit sick request; anna to approve; priya to draft handbook blurb; oliver covers 1–3pm. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
